published_prior_art.cite: ZhouTchetgenTchetgen2024Hidden supplies hidden-treatment influence-function theory, not this causal-null Gaussian fiber experiment.
Kaji2021WeakIdentification gives general weak-regularity theory, not the finite hidden-treatment-fiber affine criterion.
EvansHansenStark2005Minimax supplies the closest minimax-confidence-set duality framework; the curved-fiber connected-endpoint specialization is not shown to be subsumed.

SchaferStark2009Optimal gives Monte Carlo approximation over finite prior polytopes; SchlemperMoreira2026ConfidenceSets gives coverage-error control, neither matching two-sided certificates for this value.
Profile inversion and primal-dual complementary slackness are established decision-theoretic tools; the fiber-specific profile rule is a specialization.
EvansHansenStark2005Minimax provides the bounded-normal truncated-Pratt comparator; the hidden-treatment embedding and profile strictness benchmark are additional.
AndrewsCheng2012WeakIdentification, Cox2020WeakBounds, and Drton2009Singularities do not establish two-way Le Cam risk transfer over a moving latent observational fiber.
ZhouTchetgenTchetgen2024Hidden proves fixed-margin asymptotic inference, not the proposed moving-fiber agreement frontier.
ZwiernikSmith2012TreeCumulants studies latent-tree fibers generally; this is a new explicit arithmetic instance but not a separate broad theorem.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 / def:certified-scheme
soundness_flags.one_line: The finite level is defined over the universal graph with xi_G in X_G, but that graph is unbounded in rho and its Gaussian tail cube also grows with rho, so it cannot have the asserted finite cover or finite N_M; formulate the computation over the fixed input fiber (or an explicitly compact input neighborhood).

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2 (oeq:zhou-agreement-frontier)
soundness_flags.one_line: An arbitrary P_n in F_n is not linked to the null-fiber coordinates (w_n,q_n,sigma_n) or to the separately derived bounded-outcome experiment, so the claimed endpoint-law comparison has no defined common sequence of experiments.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Gaussian decision theorems and certified-computation target
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The results are conditional on an abstract known-radius Gaussian decision experiment and exact rational or represented real-algebraic input, not on a sampled-data causal interval.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The frontier is sharp only for the fully indexed abstract Gaussian experiment under the stated exact-input convention.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Sampled-data relevance
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The measurable sampled-data lift, vanishing fallback probability, and risk transfer remain open.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: No finite-sample causal coverage or optimal-length claim follows until Open-ended Question 1 is resolved.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 3 is mutual conditional independence of Y, A, and Z given the hidden treatment and X; Theorem 7 assumes Assumptions 2-5, bounded Y, a P-Donsker class, nuisance conditions, and gives asymptotic normality under product-rate conditions.
The stated proposition says a uniform polynomial approximation with error epsilon changes coverage from nominal by at most epsilon.
The paper presents a Monte Carlo approximation to minimax expected-size confidence sets and proves convergence to a Gamma-minimax procedure for a polytope of priors.

source_verification_receipts.version: preprint corresponding to Electronic Journal of Statistics 5 (2011)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes binary hidden-tree models using polynomial equalities together with positivity-induced inequality constraints.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the universal xi_G state graph in the certificate scheme with the fixed xi_G fiber, or state a separately compact algebraic input cell and prove the required uniform tail and chart bounds there.

Specify a common generative triangular array for Open-ended Question 2 that maps each P_n to its null-fiber coordinate and separately embeds the bounded-outcome Zhou experiment before asserting an iff agreement frontier.

Produce one completed rational curved-fiber certificate with a nonzero validated profile-regret gap; this would demonstrate that the computational object is more than a generic semi-infinite-program reduction.

recommended_next_step: Revise the certificate domain to a finite fixed-input construction and define the common experiment sequence for the Zhou comparison, then continue this angle at field tier.
